findings: Redis cache hit rate collapsed to 1.9% (149 hits vs 7862 misses). The alert named a specific hot key (cache:jobs:worker-dispatcher:hot_set); reading it back showed a 120-byte string with ~24h left on its TTL, so the key was live and being missed rather than absent. Invalidating it returned deleted=true, and re-reading the same key confirmed exists=false.
recommendation: If a similar spike recurs on the same key, investigate why it's going stale — TTL misconfiguration or an upstream write pattern not invalidating properly. Server-wide hit ratio is not the signal to watch here: this key carries no read traffic in this environment, so keyspace counters will not move whether the fix worked or not.
